verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 15 official client and server SDKs, with over 30 SDKs counting community ones. Its quickstart tells users to connect via client or backend SDKs, a code snippet shows `unleash.isEnabled`, and backend tokens are documented for authenticating SDKs. A community commenter independently confirms official clients for Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python. missing for 10: per-SDK reference documentation or a full official language list in the evidence.
